facts.text: Caroline expressed appreciation for books, stating they guide, motivate, and help her discover who she is, and this particular book reminded her to keep going and never give up.

evidence.quote: Seeing this pic just made me appreciate my love of reading even more. Books guide me, motivate me and help me discover who I am. They're a huge part of my journey, and this one's reminding me to keep going and never give up!

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that the book 'Becoming Nicole' by Amy Ellis Nutt is a real inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family, which made her feel connected and gave her hope for her own path.

evidence.quote: I loved 'Becoming Nicole' by Amy Ellis Nutt. It's a real inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family. It made me feel connected and gave me a lot of hope for my own path.

facts.text: Caroline stated that the book taught her self-acceptance, how to find support, and that tough times don't last - hope and love exist, while also noting that pets bring joy and comfort.

evidence.quote: It taught me self-acceptance and how to find support. It also showed me that tough times don't last - hope and love exist. Pets bring so much joy too, though.
